z_basis: 1-turn (1T = gray curve) digitized from per-part |Z|(f) charts (p.7). Automotive AEC-Q200, -40..125 C. Two materials: -R1 = HR1 (FM band, chart 1-1000 MHz), -T = 5HT (AM band, chart 0.01-100 MHz).
verify_note: cable_max_mm = inner diameter OD from Table 1 (5.0/8.0/12.6 mm; handling note warns cable must not exceed inner dia). z_spot is the 1-TURN (gray) curve; charts are color-coded 1T=gray, 2T=blue, 3T=orange. KEMET publishes NO numeric spot -> no external verify-back ratio. shape_norm100 = the -R1 (HR1, FM) 1T shape from ESD-SR-160519XVE-R1 @spec 100 MHz; the -R1 1T rises through a gentle peak ~300-400 MHz then ends ~500 MHz -> 1000 MHz = null. The -T (5HT, AM) parts do NOT follow shape_norm100: their charts span 0.01-100 MHz with a sharp 1T peak at ~2-4 MHz (160519-T ~70, 200836-T ~120, 301333-T ~90 ohm at peak); their z_spot is read at 1 MHz (below peak) so it understates the peak - use band=AM parts at their own low-freq spec. Reads +/-30 percent (chart states 'typical values, not guaranteed').
